translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Warmin Safirawan Ananías lulacuyashgan
Saychömi caycargan Ananías warmin Safirawan. Paycunapis wilanacurirmi chacranta ranticuyargan.
Saymi ishcan yachasinacurcur chacranta ranticuyashgan guellayta raquicuriyargan. Nircur waquilantana apostolcunaman Ananías apargan: “Caylami chacräpa chanin guellay” nishpan.

Sayno lulacuptinmi Pedro nergan: “Ananías, ¿imanirtä Satanás yäsishushgayquita chasquipar Santu Espirituta lulapänayquipä wilanacuyashcanqui? ¿Imanirtä waquin guellayta raquicurir: ‘Caylami chacräpa chanin guellay’ nicanqui?

Ranticuyashgayqui chacraga ¿manacu quiquiquicunapa cash? Chacrayquipa chanin guellaypis ¿manacu quiquiquicunapana cash? Sayno caycaptenga ¿imanirtä sayno rurayashcanqui? Runacunata lulaparpis Tayta Diosta manami lulapayta camäpacunquipäsu.”
Pedro sayno nishganta wiyarmi Ananías jinan höra wanusquergan. Sayno wanushganta musyarmi runacuna segaypa mansacäyargan.
Magtacuna
chaycamurmi Ananiaspa ayantana piturcur apar pampayargan.
Saypita quimsa höratano chargan Ananiaspa warmin Safira. Pay manami musyargansu runan wanushganta.
Chaycuptinmi Pedro taporgan: “Mä wilamay. ¿Runayqui apamushgan guellaylachöcu chacrayquita ranticuyashcanqui?” Saymi Safira nergan: “Au, saylachömi ranticuyashcä.”

Niptin Pedro nergan: “Santu Espíritu musyaycaptin ¿imanirtä yachasinacuyashcanqui lulacuyänayquipä? ¡Ricay! Puncuchönami caycäyan runayquipa ayanta pamparcur cutimog magtacuna. Lulacushgayquipita canan gampis runayquinölami wanunquipä.”
Sayno niptinmi Pedrupa naupancho Safirapis wanusquergan. Saypita magtacuna yaycur tarergan wanushgana jitaraycagta. Saymi paytapis piturcur apar runanpa naupanman pampayargan.
Ananiaswan Safira lulacuyashganpita wanuyashganta musyaycurmi waugui-panincuna y waquin runacunapis fiyupa mansacäyargan.
Gueshyagcunata apostolcuna aliyäsiyashgan
Runacuna ricaycäyaptinmi Diospa munayninwan apostolcuna milagrucunata rurayag. Saynöpis Tayta Diosninsiman yäracogcuna imaypis templuman shuntacäyag Salomón nishgan alarman.
Ananiasta Tayta Diosninsi sayno castigashganta musyaycurmi waquin runacuna paycunawan shuntacäyargannasu. Paycunawan mana shuntacarpis paycunata alimi ricayag.
Ali wilacuyta wiyagcunaga waran waranmi warmipis olgupis Jesucristuta chasquicuyargan. Saynöpami más ascayäyargan Jesucristuman yäracogcuna.
Cällipa Pedro päsaptinmi gueshyagcunata jorgayämog cämantinta cayno yarpäyashpan: “Pedro päsaptin lantuylanpis jananman chaptenga aliyangami.”
Cercacho cag marcacunapitapis gueshyagcunatawan supay nacasishgancunatapis apacurcurmi Jerusalenman runacuna shayämog. Say apayashgan gueshyagcunatami apostolcuna lapanta aliyäsiyargan.
Apostolcunata autoridäcuna prësu sariyashgan
Gueshyagcunata aliyäsishganta musyarmi más mandag cüra y paywan pureg saduceo runacunapis apostolcunapa contran sharcuyargan.
Saymi prësu sariycasir carcilman wichgasiyargan.
Say sacaymi Tayta Diosninsipa angilnin chaycur cárcil puncucunata quichapargan. Nircurmi wagtaman jorgurir apostolcunata nergan:
“Aywayay templupa jatun patiunman. Saycho runacunata wilapäyay Jesucristuta chasquicuptin Tayta Diosninsi salvananpä cashganta.”

Saymi templupa jatun patiunman waraynin tuta apostolcuna yaycuyargan. Saychömi ángil nishgannöla runacunata wilapäyargan. Más mandag cüranami cüra mayincunawan gayasimorgan Israel runacunapa lapan autoridänincunata sesionta rurayänanpä. Paycunawan wilanacurcurmi wardiacunata cachayargan carcilpita apostolcunata jorgayämunanpä.
Wardiacuna carcilman chaycuyashpan manami tariyargannasu apostolcunata. Saymi cutiycur niyargan:
“Cárcil puncuta shumag wichgaraycagtami tariyashcä. Prësu cuidagcunatapis puncucunacho ichiraycäyagtami tariyashcä. Ruriman yaycurmi isanga maygan prësutapis tariyashcäsu.”
Sayta wiyaycurmi más mandag cürapis, templucho wardiacunapa capitanninpis y waquin mandag cüracunapis yarpachacuyargan: “¿Imanöparä gueshpisquiyash? ¿Imatanarä masta rurasquiyanga?” niyashpan.
Sayno yarpachacuycäyaptinmi juc runa chaycur nergan: “¡Carcilman wichgayashgayqui runacunaga templo patiuchömi runacunata yapay yachaycäsiyan!”
Sayno niptin wardiacunata pushacurcur capitán aywargan apostolcunata prësu sarimunanpä. Mana magaylapami prësu sarircur apayargan runacuna samgayänanta mansacuyashpan.
Saymi apostolcunata chäsiyargan autoridäcuna shuntaraycäyashganman. Saychönami más mandag cüra nergan:

“¿Manacu gamcunata niyashcä imaypis Jesuspita manana yachasiyänayquipä? Sayno nicäyaptëga ¿imanirtä yachaycäsiyanqui runacunata? Nircurpis nogacunata jitapaycäyämanqui: ‘Paycunami Jesusta wanusiyash’ niyashpayqui.”
Sayno niptin Pedro y waquin cag apostolcunapis niyargan: “Runacunata cäsucuyänäpa trucanga Tayta Diosninsitami cäsucuyäshä.
Gamcuna Jesusta crucificaypa wanusiyaptiquipis unay Israel mayinsicuna yäracuyashgan Tayta Diosninsimi wanushganpita cawarisimush.

Nircurmi lapanpita más munayyog cananpä payta derëcha cag lädunman jamasish. Saynöpis churash mandamagninsi y salvamagninsi cananpämi. Sayno churash carmi payta chasquicogcunata lapantapis jusalicushgancunata perdonash.
Saycunata wilacuyänäpämi Santu Espirituta Tayta Diosninsi nogacunaman cachamush. Pï-maytapis pay nishganta cäsucogtaga Santu Espíritu yanapaycanmi.”
Sayno niyashganta wiyaycurmi autoridäcuna fiyupa rabiacuyashpan wanusiyta munayargan.

Paycunawanmi caycargan Moisés guelgashgan leycunata yachaseg juc fariseo runa. Paypa jutinmi cargan Gamaliel. Lapan runacunami payta respitayag. Paymi wardiacunata mandargan apostolcunata wagtaman rätula jorgusquiyänanpä.
Sayno jorgurcasirmi saycho caycag autoridäcunata nergan: “Israel mayëcuna, cay runacunapa contran imatapis manarä rurar shumag yarpachacuyay.

¿Yarpäyanquicu juc cuticho Teudas jutiyog runa: ‘Yachag runami cä’ nir sumäsir purishganta? Paytami gatirargan chuscu pachac (400) runacuna. Sayno puriycagta wanuscasiyaptin gatiragnincuna wacpa caypami mashtacar aywacuyargan.
Saypita censacuy cashgan wisan purergan Galilea provinciapita shamog Judaspis. Saynölami paytapis wanuscasiptin lapan gatiragnincuna, asca carpis, mashtacar ushacäcuyargan.
Saymi noga yäsë cay runacunawan mana churacänansipä. Saypa trucanga paycunata amana cäsupäshunsu. Quiquinpa yarpaylanpita wilacuyaptenga saylachönami usharanga.
Tayta Diosninsipa wilacuynin captenga imata rurashgapis sïguengami. Shumag mana tantyacuypa paycunata wanuserga cuidä Diospa contran ruraycashwan.”

Saymi Gamaliel nishganta cäsucuyashpan apostolcunata manana wanusiyargannasu. Wanusiyänanpa trucanga cutiycasimurmi astasergan. Astarcasirmi niyargan: “¡Cananpitaga amana wilacuyanquisu Jesuspita!” Sayno juraparcurmi cachasquiyargan.
Cachasquiyaptinmi apostolcuna cushish aywacuyargan. Sayno cushicuyargan Jesucristu-raycu autoridäcuna astayashganpitami.
Autoridäcuna michaycäyaptinpis paycunaga waran waranmi runacunata yachasiyargan: “Jesusga salvamagninsi Cristumi” niyashpan. Saynölami templo patiucho y wayicunachöpis wilacuyag.
